reason: Both are building-systems contractors selling installation and maintenance services to commercial and industrial owners and contractors. APi's core is fire protection, life safety, HVAC and elevator inspection and maintenance. IES's core is electrical and communications contracting for data centers, residential and commercial buildings, plus custom power equipment manufacturing. The customers overlap, but the main services mostly differ. The saved site lines I can cite don't show IES doing fire, life safety or elevator work.
